newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe stocks slip after recent highs.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe stocks slip after recent highs.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial stocks lost a bit of ground on Thursday after weeks of breaking records daily with brokers saying prices had become too high to be sustainable.
The key 57-share industrial index, which shot through the 10,000 pyschological mark on Monday, slipped 2.18 points to close at 10,321.68 on the back of losses in a couple of heavyweight counters.
Minings continued mixed in lacklustre trade with Falgold trading five cents higher on the back of a firmer gold price on international markets.
The seven-counter mining index lost 22.41 points to end at 1,119.13.
